question: Which film won the Best Feature Film at the 71st National Film Awards?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**12th Fail**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 71st National Film Awards 2025: Shah Rukh Khan, Rani Mukerji win first National Awards; Vikrant Massey and 12th Fail bag trophies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **71st National Film Awards** were announced at the **National Media Centre, New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Feature Film**: *12th Fail* by **Vidhu Vinod Chopra**.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Actor (Leading Role)**: Shared by **Shah Rukh Khan** (*Jawan*) and **Vikrant Massey** (*12th Fail*).

 
 
• 
 
**Best Actress (Leading Role)**: **Rani Mukerji** for *Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Direction**: **Sudipto Sen** for *The Kerala Story*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Supporting Actor**: **Vijayaraghavan** and **Muthupettai Somu Bhaska*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Supporting Actress**: **Janki Bodiwala** and **Urvashi**.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Popular Film for Entertainment**: *Rocky Aur Rani Ki Prem Kahani*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Hindi Film**: *Kathal*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Malayalam Film**: *Ullazhukku*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Tamil Film**: *Parking*.

 
 
• 
 
**Best Telugu Film**: *Bhagavanth Kesari*.

 
 
• 
 
Eligibility: Films certified by **CBFC** between **Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2023**.
